entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Gothic horror plane where the darkness is ascending and angels are weakened.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who protected Innistrad with flights of angels before being forced into the Helvault.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison into which Avacyn was forced.

entities.name: Angels of Innistrad
entities.description: Ranks of angels who served Avacyn and now lurk, ineffective without her presence.

entities.name: Collar of Avacyn
entities.description: Holy symbol used by Avacynian priests and vampire-hunters to channel faith and ward off evil.

events.summary: Avacyn is forced into the Helvault, leaving her flights of angels unable to protect Innistrad as before.
events.quote: Back before Avacyn was forced into the Helvault

events.summary: Without Avacyn the angels suffer wounds and must retreat and bide their time against Innistrad's shadowy creatures.
events.quote: They suffer wounds and have to retreat.

relations.quote: she had many ranks, or "flights," of other angels serving her

relations.note: Avacyn was forced into the Helvault
relations.quote: Back before Avacyn was forced into the Helvault
